title: nothaphoebe alpigena
intro: Nothaphoebe alpigena, commonly known as Himalayan cinnamon or Chinese cinnamon, is a plant species belonging to the family Lauraceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Nothaphoebe alpigena are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, alleviate digestive problems, and serve as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include caryophyllene, limonene, and beta-caryophyllene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
